svg.title: Asthma danger gate and blue-grey salbutamol puffer first aid
svg.desc: Working Australian asthma first-aid card in three parts. First check response and breathing. If the person is unresponsive and not breathing normally, including gasping or uncertain breathing, call Triple Zero and start CPR on a firm surface. Call Triple Zero immediately for severe or rapidly worsening breathing trouble, inability to speak comfortably, blue lips, drowsiness, little or no relief from a reliever, no reliever, or doubt. When known asthma overlaps with a known severe allergy after possible contact with that severe allergen, follow the anaphylaxis cards: give the person's current adrenaline device first if available and as the plan and exact device direct, call Triple Zero, use the correct anaphylaxis position and then follow the asthma plan. Otherwise keep a conscious person comfortably upright, stay with them and follow their current asthma plan and exact reliever instructions. Only when there is no plan and the device is a recognised blue-grey salbutamol puffer, give four separate puffs, preferably through a spacer: shake, put one puff into the spacer, take four breaths, then repeat until four puffs have been given. Wait four minutes. If there is little or no improvement, repeat four puffs. If still not improving, or at any time severe or worsening, call Triple Zero and continue four puffs every four minutes while awaiting help. Do not transfer this dose sequence to a different inhaler. If no reliever is available, call Triple Zero and do not substitute steam, a paper bag or improvised medicine. If the call will not connect, keep care going and use Chapter 3's emergency-contact route without leaving the person merely to seek reception.
svg.text: ASTHMA ATTACK — DANGER FIRST
WORKING CARD · PART 1 OF 3
RESPIRATORY AND DEVICE REVIEW STILL REQUIRED
Subjective estimates: source wording 93%; new layout 60%.
These are not probabilities of correct treatment, recovery or survival.
Use all parts together. Follow 000, the current plan and exact device.
UNRESPONSIVE AND NOT BREATHING NORMALLY?
Gasping or unsure counts. Call 000. Use a firm surface.
Start CPR now. Do not work through the inhaler steps first.
CALL 000 NOW — DO NOT WAIT FOUR MINUTES
• breathing trouble is severe or becoming worse quickly
• cannot speak comfortably, lips look blue, or becoming drowsy
• little or no relief, no reliever available, or you are unsure
Keep giving supported first aid while help is arranged.
COULD THIS BE ANAPHYLAXIS?
Known asthma + known severe allergy + sudden breathing trouble after
possible contact: follow the anaphylaxis cards. Give their current
adrenaline device first if available and as directed; call 000 and use
the correct position, then the asthma plan. Do not wait for a rash.
WORKING DRAFT — CONTINUE TO PART 2
BLUE/GREY PUFFER — THE 4 × 4 × 4 START
WORKING CARD · PART 2 OF 3
ONLY IF THERE IS NO PLAN AND YOU RECOGNISE THE DEVICE
This part is only for a blue/grey salbutamol puffer. A different reliever,
dry-powder inhaler or combination inhaler has different instructions.
SIT COMFORTABLY UPRIGHT · STAY · REASSURE
Do not leave the person alone. Start now; severe signs still mean 000 now.
WITH A SPACER — GIVE 4 SEPARATE PUFFS
Shake the puffer. Put it upright into the spacer.
Press once: one puff into the spacer.
Take 4 breaths in and out through the spacer.
Repeat one puff + four breaths until 4 puffs are given.
WAIT 4 MINUTES — WATCH BREATHING
Any worsening or severe sign means 000 immediately. Do not finish the wait.
WORKING DRAFT — CONTINUE TO PART 3
AFTER FOUR MINUTES — RECHECK
WORKING CARD · PART 3 OF 3
LITTLE OR NO IMPROVEMENT?
Give another 4 separate puffs by the same spacer method.
Still not improving, or severe/worsening at any time? Call 000.
Keep giving 4 puffs every 4 minutes while awaiting help.
Breathing normally again? Stop extra doses and seek medical review promptly.
DIFFERENT RELIEVER OR NO RELIEVER
Different device: follow the current plan and exact device instructions.
No reliever: call 000 now. No steam, paper bag or improvised medicine.
WITH A KIT
• matched reliever + spacer
• current plan + timer
WITHOUT A KIT
• use the person’s correct reliever
• none available: 000; no substitute
000 will not connect? Keep care going; use Chapter 3. Do not leave merely for signal.
